note: The United Kingdom's Immigration Rules, which the Crown Dependencies follow for visits: a national of a country in Appendix Visitor: Visa National List needs a visa before travelling (Hong Kong's and Macao's SAR passports, and Taiwan's carrying the identity card number, excepted, VN 2.2); a national of a country in Appendix ETA National List needs an electronic travel authorisation to come as a visitor for up to 6 months; Irish citizens need no leave at all (Immigration Act 1971 s. 3ZA). Between them the two lists name every other country; British nationals of the overseas territories, whose nationality is the United Kingdom's, are home (and need no ETA, ETA 1.7). Stateless people and any document other than a national passport need a visa (VN 1.1(b)-(c)), as does every passport the lists don't name. The temporary ETA concession for Nicaragua and St Lucia (VN 2.2(t)) ended on 16 April 2026.

sources.title: Immigration Act 1971, s. 3ZA, Irish citizens (legislation.gov.uk)
sources.said: An Irish citizen does not require leave to enter or remain in the United Kingdom, unless subsection (2), (3) or (4) applies to that citizen.
